app.name: HerdCommand
app.tagline: Herd operations from the field to the dashboard

portal.title: Farm portal
portal.body: This is the farm workspace. More field tools will land here.

admin.forbidden: This page is available to system administrators only.
admin.forbiddenHint: Ask an owner or administrator if you need to manage breeds.
admin.platformForbidden: This page is available to platform administrators only.
admin.platformForbiddenHint: Managing every farm needs the Keycloak PLATFORM_ADMIN role. A farm owner cannot see other farms.

farmSettings.title: Farm management
farmSettings.subtitle: Search, inspect, and support every farm on the platform
farmSettings.wizardLater: The creation wizard arrives in a later story.
farmSettings.apiReady: Platform APIs are available for this account.
farmSettings.loadError: Could not load the farm list.
farmSettings.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, code, or owner email...
farmSettings.editLater: Farm editing arrives in a later story.
farmSettings.suspendLater: Suspend and reactivate arrive in a later story.
farmSettings.note: Counts and rows come from the platform APIs. No production farms are hardcoded. Edit and suspend stay for later stories.
farmSettings.featuresHint: Selections are stored by feature code. Coming-soon modules cannot be enabled.
farmSettings.featuresEmpty: No features were returned from the catalog.
farmSettings.ownerHint: Look up the owner by email. Authentication stays in Keycloak. Ownership is stored here after the farm is created.
farmSettings.ownerFound: Found {name}. This account can be assigned when the farm is created.
farmSettings.ownerInvite: No Keycloak account yet. An invitation email will be sent after farm creation.
farmSettings.ownerDisabled: This Keycloak account is disabled and cannot own a farm.
farmSettings.ownerError: Could not reach the identity service.

wizard.title: Add a farm
wizard.nameEnHelp: Optional. If empty, the French name is stored as the English name.
wizard.statusHelp: New farms start in setup. The code is generated by the server.
wizard.ownerPhoneHelp: Optional E.164 number. It is validated and not stored.
wizard.ownerFound: This Keycloak account can be assigned as the farm owner.
wizard.planCaps: Server caps: {animals} animals, {team} team members. Client values are not sent.
wizard.lookupFirst: Wait for the owner lookup to finish.

animalSettings.title: Animal settings
animalSettings.subtitle: Manage the reference data used to register and classify animals
animalSettings.confirmDeactivate: Deactivate breed {code}? It stays in records and is not deleted.
animalSettings.farmLoadError: Could not load a farm for groups.
animalSettings.groupSearchPlaceholder: Search groups by name or code...
animalSettings.note: Breeds are shared reference data. A breed in use cannot be deleted; deactivate it so historical animals keep their breed.
animalSettings.statusNote: Status labels and colors are display only. They do not change what the technical code means for animals already using that status.
animalSettings.previewHelp: Updates as you type. Nothing is saved until you click Save.
animalSettings.cannotDeactivateActive: ACTIVE cannot be deactivated. Every animal catalog needs this status.
animalSettings.confirmDeactivateStatus: Deactivate status {code}? Existing animals keep it. It is not deleted.
animalSettings.codeHelp: Uppercase English letters, for example NAJDI
animalSettings.codeImmutable: The code cannot be changed after creation.
animalSettings.groupCodeHelp: Uppercase English letters, for example DAMS-1
animalSettings.capacityHelp: Optional. Leave empty if there is no limit.
animalSettings.groupNote: Groups belong to one farm. They are not a shared catalog like breeds. Animals will be assigned to these groups later; counts stay 0 for now.
animalSettings.confirmDeactivateGroup: Deactivate group {code}? It stays in records and is not deleted.

home.title: Product foundation
home.body: This release establishes the design system, Arabic as the default locale, and Keycloak sign-in.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use your farm account on the secure HerdCommand sign-in page.
auth.hint: You will continue to your local Keycloak to enter username and password.
auth.demo: Use an existing user in the herdcommand realm.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

validation.unauthorized: Sign in is required to continue.
validation.server: An unexpected error occurred. Try again.

preview.title: Keycloak login preview
preview.hint: Look only — it does not talk to Keycloak. Nafath and Google are visual, not real login.
